Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DICES Dataset: Diversity in Conversational AI Evaluation for Safety (2306.11247v1) · paper method: For DICES-350, a trust/safety gold rating is first assigned by one rater and verified by a pool of five experts; the paper reports disagreement with the crowd-majority label in 34% of examples.

DICES Dataset: Diversity in Conversational AI Evaluation for Safety (2306.11247v1) · paper method: The paper identifies small conversation count, restricted demographic categories and unresolved separation of sincere belief differences from task/rater noise as limitations, despite high replication of ratings.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DICES Dataset: Diversity in Conversational AI Evaluation for Safety (2306.11247v1) · paper method: DICES-350 rater quality assessment considers unusually short annotation time and invariant conversation labels; the paper removes 19 raters before its 104-rater analysis.

cohort3.claim.dices.quality-filter

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific author-reported study; experiments, raw dataset records and formal proofs were not independently reproduced or verified.
  • Counts of raters recruited, retained, ratings and safety-question annotations must not be conflated.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DICES Dataset: Diversity in Conversational AI Evaluation for Safety (2306.11247v1) · paper method: DICES-990 recruits 173 US/India raters with partial conversation coverage; DICES-350 recruits a different 123-rater US pool, then excludes 19 raters and reports results from 104 raters who each annotate all 350 conversations.
